smu_lkcsb_top_tier.tier_name: not found (no public official LKCSB journal list located)
notes: No official LKCSB/SMU journal list with an 'A+' (or other top) tier was found via web search (multiple query variants, incl. site-restricted).

business.smu.edu.sg (and graduatestudies.smu.edu.sg) is behind an Imperva/Incapsula bot check: curl returns a challenge page and the in-app browser showed an 'Additional security check is required' CAPTCHA, which was NOT bypassed.

Wayback Machine CDX index of business.smu.edu.sg uploaded files (~1,900 URLs) contains no journal-list document; SMU Libraries research guides (researchguides.smu.edu.sg/researchsupport, Journal Impact page) point only to external lists (Harzing JQL, ABDC, CWTS), not an SMU list.
The list is likely internal (faculty handbook / promotion criteria). Ask SMU LKCSB research office or a faculty member for the current PDF; do not infer it from FT50/UTD24.
Public SMU communications describe research standing via FT50 (FT Research Insights / Aggregated ranking) and UTD24, not via a named A+ tier.

Whether FT keeps SMR on the list was not found.
